semantics: All pre-V2 and pre-boundary historical evidence is DEVELOPMENT by default.
Evidence designated PROTECTED at or after this boundary must remain hidden from hypothesis generation, parameter selection, candidate ranking and Discovery iteration.
Protected evidence is not opened candidate-by-candidate.
Once protected evidence is opened for final validation it is permanently consumed.
No retroactive untouched-OOS relabeling is permitted.
This boundary does not manufacture untouched historical OOS before the timestamp.
